Theorem
[At least linear volume growth (Theorem 27.50)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0050 ↗ thm:chow-iv-sharp-log-sobolev 1. ch27:27.50\group Shrinker geometry at infinity

For every base point $p$ there is $c>0$ such that $\operatorname {Area}S(p,r)\ge 2c$ for $r\ge 1/2$ and $\operatorname {Vol}B_p(r)\ge cr$ for $r\ge 1$.
